description: This file contains function declarations (prototypes) for retrieving parameter values and instance numbers in a C-based project, specifically related to the Cosa API utilities used in the broader RDK/BroadWay system. It serves as an interface for other source files to interact with data model parameters.
external_methods: int CosaGetParamValueString(char* pParamName, char* pBuffer, PULONG pulSize)

methods.name: CosaGetParamValueUlong
methods.description: Retrieves an unsigned long value for a given parameter name.

methods.name: CosaGetParamValueString
methods.description: Retrieves a string value for a given parameter name, storing it in the provided buffer.

methods.name: CosaGetParamValueBool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean value for a given parameter name.

methods.name: CosaGetInstanceNumberByIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the instance number of an object by index.
